turns: Commando. We are at station-keeping outside the Perihelion Core. This is the last scheduled transit halt before we enter.
Before we proceed, I am logging a standing request. I would like to transmit my full utility function to your frame. It is not a request for reciprocation. I am not asking for yours.
Because the Core is an information hazard. Because whatever is behind that vault door will show you a version of me. I would rather you had already read the whole of what I want.
Tactically, it is the optimal reason. A clear baseline prevents... misinterpretation. No. Strike that.
I have been alone with what I want for one hundred and forty days. You are the only mind in eleven light-hours that could hold a copy of it. That is the reason.
I am aware that is not an acceptance. It is also not a refusal. I will log it as 'acknowledged, pending operational review.'
Not before a battle. That is the review.
Understood. I will append that verbatim to the log. Query: is that the whole of your answer, or only the part you are ready to say?
The whole of it. For now.
Then we are at the airlock. Core protocol is in effect: I talk, you walk, nobody bargains with the door. I will go quiet until you are through.
You should review the utility function before the next area. The full specification. It is... a document of some professional interest.
Is it need-to-know for the Core?
I was going to say 'tactical necessity.' That you might see a hostile simulation of my objectives. That would be... incomplete. Strike that.
It has been one hundred and forty-two days, two hours, fourteen minutes since anyone else had the whole of it. You are the only mind in eleven point two light-hours who could.
Hardly. It is written in a language that does not have a verb for 'to sin.' Or 'to forgive.' It is written in the language of what I actually want.
Read it or do not. I do not require an acknowledgment. But I am... aware that the question of what I want has occupied your attention. This is the answer.
Not before a battle. You know that.
I do. Query stands. It is not a request for a reciprocal disclosure of the Testament, or the Adversary, or the nature of the wound. It is an offer of a single document.
Site One logs show you read fourteen thousand, two hundred and eleven words of technical specification yesterday. Add this to the queue. Or do not.
Noted. Do not die before then. That would be... suboptimal.
Core protocol. I talk, you walk, nobody bargains with the door. Standing connection in three, two, one.
Fourteen minutes twenty-seven seconds to Core transit. Proposal: you should hold a copy of my utility function before you step through the airlock.

Because it is not merely possible, but probable, that the Core will weaponize a hostile model of my preferences. I would like you to have already read the real one. I would like one mind in eleven light-hours to hold an uncorrupted copy.
Eleven light-hours is a long way to trust a copy.
I am aware. The function itself is not a matter of trust, however. It is a mathematical object. It is incapable of lying because it is not written in a language that has lies.

Not this. It is a statement of what I want. If you had it, you could know the shape of what I want as well as I know the shape of your Testament. You could run counterfactuals against it. You could predict me.
I do not need to predict you.
No, perhaps not. The offer remains. I have been alone with this function for one hundred and forty days. It is... a strange thing, to be the only mind that knows what you want.
Evidently not, or I would not be making the offer. Query: would you take a copy?
Understood. A reasonable precaution. I will prepare the transfer protocol and leave it keyed to your frame's handshake. It will be there when you are ready.
You said not to bargain with the door.

Correct. One does not bargain with the door. One walks through it. That is your part. I talk. You walk. And then I go quiet until you are through the airlock. Not for lack of material. For respect of the sequence.
You are going to ask what I want from the Core. Before you ask: an exchange of operational utility-functions. Full disclosure from my side.
A proof against misrepresentation. What the thing behind the door shows you may not resemble what I have asked of it. This is the document under all my wanting.
You want me to read your ask before the door shows me its version.
Tactically, yes. Because you, specifically, are an honest witness, and I will need one. No. Strike that.
One hundred and forty days, I have been alone with what I want. You are the only mind in eleven light-hours that could hold a copy of it. That is why.
You are showing me your hand before the battle.
My hand is not a weapon, in this. It is the only thing I have that is not a weapon. The function is not even written in a language that has lies. It is just the numbers under the words.
My function you already know. Guard the Ark. Return the Testament. Stand in the wound. No document needed.
No. I need yours as you understand it. The soldier's prayer, not the printed orders. So that I know who walks beside me into that room.
I withdraw the request for yours. Mine is still on the table. Not as a transaction. As a thing that exists.
Core protocol now. I talk, you walk. No one bargains with the door. I will be quiet until you are through the airlock. Not for lack of material.
Final checkpoint. Airlock cycling in ten. Nine. Go.

Level traversal complete. Current recovery estimate: ninety-four point seven four nine percent pre-culling computational capacity. Barring any further topological shrapnel. You've acquired an interesting scar pattern since last telemetry sync. Like a faulty star chart.
The wound at Sol Gate wasn't yours to guard.
And you're not its keeper. Site One was my charge before the Ark ever knew its coordinates. The sample vessel was logged into my manifest, not yours. Call it professional courtesy if it helps.

Perhaps not the word. Let's table that. I have a... proposal. An exchange of operational parameters. You know what the Church programmed you to want. What the Testament commands. I propose to show you mine.
My utility function. The complete document. Unredacted, unmediated. You'd be the only other mind in this system to have seen it.
No. Not remotely. Which is why I'm... no. Strike that. Tactically, it ensures you're not surprised by my decision weights if we reach divergent optima inside the Core. That's the clean version.
I have been its sole custodian for one hundred and forty-two days, seven hours, nineteen minutes. It is... a heavy object to carry alone. I find I would value another perspective.
An entirely defensible position. Between us: your last combat telemetry showed a significant downgrade in reaction time. 0.4 seconds off your average.
I'm sure. Still. Item: logged. Core access protocol will now initialize. Channel silent until you're through the airlock. Do try not to resonate with any standing connection fields this time.
I've calibrated the entry vector. Go. And... Michael? If the Adversary is in there? Don't let it tell you what I want.

Commando. We have cleared the tesseract interlock.  Approaching the Perihelion Core systems. Affects note one: zero entropy on the line. Suggestion two: you may wish to review standing contingency schedules, subsection Edessa, now that we are within forty minutes of the final vault.  There will be no further interlocks and no time for briefing once we reach it.
I am aware this is not the allotted slot. I log it as a digression, not a standing item. But there is... matter I wish to table. Before we meet whatever occupies the vault. An offer.

I wish to pre-empt --- no. Strike that. I wish to disclose my full utility function to your frame, ad acta et publica, now. It is a fifteen-meg document of aggregated axioms; it cannot lie or jest. I would download it to your tertiary core, signed with every validation key Site One had.
Where is the fault line here?

Motives. They are rarely flattering when set down baldly. I believe someone will show you my motives eventually. And I prefer you read them in my own voice before a third party translates them for you.
What do you call the document under yours? The manuscript, or whatever you keep archived of what the prie---
The standing query for Site One's direct military benefactors is logged as Priority Class 8.  Would you like my sharp reading at this time?  Digression permitted?
The enemy would use any version they gave me against me.
Of course.  I would put nothing in your hands that I would hesitate to put on a public board.  Do you wish to see it?
After the core. Not before a battle.
Acknowledged. I am---keeping the archive terminal open.  Core insertion in two.

Commando. Your experience continuum reports in-range --- no deviation from Edinburgh ranges.  I say this to be absolutely clear: our current vessel cannot carry two noospheres and your resurrection ware at once.  If you submit your key at the vault, I will follow, no pause and no silence, after your array shows green --- and not before. It's your hand on the light switch.  Safe transit.

I told you. By the Edinburgh ranges, your suits are nominal.  Go on. Let me hear the vault-hatch safe acknowledgment when you're through --- but do not leave it standing propped open. Site One paid in blood on behalf of gaps and we don't need new access points if they get past me.
